name: com.pixi.webbridge
description: WebBridge components for React-Unity communication. Provides the game-agnostic WebBridgeBase, a bridge per mode (RoadWebBridge, PlinkoWebBridge, PlinkoAztecWebBridge, WheelWebBridge, JumperWebBridge, MineSlotWebBridge) and the LayoutWebBridge, AudioWebBridge, TranslationsWebBridge and ScreenOrientationWebBridge service bridges.
